description: This file contains unit tests for legacy endpoint validation in the Data Asset Management System backend, focusing on validating request payloads for site assets management endpoints.

classes.name: LegacyObservedEndpointsValidationTests
classes.description: A test class using Xunit to validate the behavior of legacy site asset management endpoints, verifying proper handling of invalid requests.

methods.name: Legacy_manageSiteAssets_requires_mode
methods.description: Tests that the '/api/siteassets/managesiteassets' endpoint returns BadRequest when 'mode' is missing or invalid.

methods.name: Legacy_manageSiteAssets_update_requires_assetId_and_update_payload
methods.description: Tests that the update operation requires 'assetId' and 'update' payload, and returns BadRequest if missing.

methods.name: Legacy_removeSiteAsset_requires_required_fields
methods.description: Tests that the remove operation endpoint requires 'assetId', 'modifiedBy', and 'correlationId' fields, returning BadRequest if any are null or missing.
